page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c8g1.2xlarge is a KVM-based virtual machine instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading, operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz. The instance is equipped with 30.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.75 GB per core. For accelerated workloads, it integrates a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is supported by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results place the instance in the average tier for general CPU and memory tasks, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1580.0 and a multi-core score of 5901.0. However, the hardware excels in specialized workloads. In LLM inference tests using a small 135M model, it achieves top-tier performance with 9665.83 tokens per second for prompt processing and 456.78 tokens per second for text generation. For a medium 7B model, prompt processing reaches 2504.89 tokens per second and text generation reaches 90.71 tokens per second, also placing it in the top tier. The CPU supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and cryptography extensions like AES and SHA_NI.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn7i-c8g1.2xlarge offers a balanced entry point for GPU-accelerated computing, pairing a mid-range dedicated CPU configuration with a professional-grade Ampere GPU without the overhead of local NVMe storage. This makes it highly suitable for small to medium-sized machine learning inference, ray tracing, image processing, and video transcoding. It is also well-suited for general-purpose workloads that require occasional GPU acceleration alongside standard compute tasks, though it is not configured for massive datasets that require local high-speed storage or large-scale LLM training.
